Timeline::week_scalar¶

Back to Timeline API Reference

Signature¶

int Timeline::week_scalar() const

Read One ISO Week Number¶

week_scalar() returns the local date’s ISO week number, 1..53. ISO weeks begin on Monday, and week 1 is the week containing January 4. Consequently, the first days of January can belong to week 52 or 53, while the final days of December can belong to week 1 of the following ISO week-year.

The method returns only the week number. Do not pair it blindly with year_scalar() as a unique ISO year-week key: the two calendars disagree at some New Year boundaries. It is appropriate when the week number itself is needed; a complete ISO week identity also requires the corresponding ISO week-year.

Use week() for shape-preserving array extraction.

Example: January Can Still Be Week 53¶

const auto friday = pluss::timeline::make("2021-01-01T12:00:00Z");
const auto monday = pluss::timeline::make("2021-01-04T12:00:00Z");
std::cout << "2021-01-01=" << friday.week_scalar()
          << ", 2021-01-04=" << monday.week_scalar() << '\n';

Output¶

2021-01-01=53, 2021-01-04=1

Example: Civil Year And ISO Week Can Diverge¶

const auto t = pluss::timeline::make("2024-12-31T12:00:00Z");
std::cout << "year=" << t.year_scalar()
          << ", week=" << t.week_scalar() << '\n';

Output¶

year=2024, week=1

The 1 belongs to the next ISO week-year even though the civil year field is still 2024.

Example: Absence And Rank Validation¶

std::cout << "absent=" << pluss::timeline::make("").week_scalar() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::timeline::make({"2021-01-04T12:00:00Z"}).week_scalar();
} catch (const std::exception&) {
  std::cout << "one-element vector rejected\n";
}

Output¶

absent=-1
one-element vector rejected

Contract Summary¶

  • Valid output is 1..53; NaT returns -1.

  • Weeks begin Monday and follow ISO New Year rules.

  • Rank zero is mandatory; no implicit first-element extraction occurs.

  • The active timezone determines the local date before classification.

  • The operation does not mutate or round the Timeline.

See Also¶

  • week(): shape-preserving ISO week extraction.

  • weekday_scalar(): Monday-zero weekday.

  • year_scalar(): civil year, not necessarily ISO week-year.
